stories.title: Flint lifeboat volunteer marks station’s 60th anniversary with River Dee litter challenge
stories.summary: A Flint RNLI volunteer is aiming to clear 60 bags of rubbish from the banks of the River Dee to mark the lifeboat station’s 60th anniversary. stories.title: Former Land Girl Kate Corbett marks 100th birthday with party at Halkyn Cricket Club
stories.summary: A Bagillt woman who drove tractors as a Land Girl during the Second World War has celebrated her 100th birthday at Halkyn Cricket Club. stories.title: Cable theft delays on Wales and Borders rail route almost double in a year, Network Rail figures show
stories.summary: Ten cable thefts caused 292 hours of train delays across Wales and the borders in a year and cost more than £955,000, Network Rail figures show. stories.summary: School transport operators have asked Flintshire County Council for higher contract payments because of fuel costs, and no extra money has been agreed. stories.title: Mold archive plan for Flintshire and Denbighshire set for approval
stories.summary: Plans for a new joint archive serving Flintshire and Denbighshire are set to be approved next week. Flintshire County Council has applied to its own planning committee for a purpose-built building on land next to Theatr Clwyd, off Raikes Lane in Mold, to house the archive services and collections of both councils.
